docs.reaching.component: `Reaching` defines how far past its own outline a node still counts as being at something.
A bounding box says where an element is. It says nothing about the space around it, yet game
rules constantly care about that space: two adjacent chips forming a single pot, a card dropped
near a zone belonging to that zone, or pieces a hair apart counting as touching.
import { node, Bounded, Reaching, rect } from "game-kit";
Reach is measured in root units outward from the node's outline, not from its center. A reach from
the center would vary at every edge of any non-circular shape, which is not what "near" means.
